g.text: SCR04 — Groups for a job
Kotlin Compose screen definition · FR-GRP-01 / 02 / 03 · blueprint2.0 design only
Service Running (desired running) · MCP ready · ADB offline · view ready · catalog ready · ARC disabled · 10
Phone390dp: Summary search and selected group details; member editor opens separate full-screen draft. Modal drawer below840dp; persistent rail at840dp+.
Back returns previous detail, with Discard/Stay for dirty drafts. Landscape: Same IDs and authorization; wide layout only when available width>=840dp; never
shrink protected actions below48dp.
SCR04.C01 · Inspect group summary
Fields: Stable group ID/revision/hash, dependencies and permission/applicability facets
Open selected functional group summary without schemas for unrelated groups
Failure: Missing/deleted group stays searchable as historical/unassigned; cannot activate unknown membership
SCR04.C02 · Save group mapping
Fields: Small atomic member IDs, paired register/unregister, required types and provenance
SCR09 approves exact local group-mapping create/update with CAS
Failure: Budget/dependency/conflict error saves no partial group or activation
SCR04.C03 · Open navigation
Fields: SCR01..SCR08,SCR10,SCR11; protected review only via exact command
Open all local destinations through phone drawer or wide rail; Back returns previous screen
Failure: Dirty draft requires Discard/Stay; navigation never commits configuration
SCR04.C04 · Select client/session
Fields: Exact client ID/session epoch; local UI does not impersonate MCP client
Choose client/session only for owner preview of interest/permission status
Failure: Expired session shows no activation option; client must initialize again
SCR04.C05 · Describe job
Fields: Job text, applicable target, desired max_bytes and pagination limit
Edit task description and optional deterministic search constraints
Failure: Text is untrusted data, never grants or executable instructions
SCR04.C06 · Search group summaries
Fields: Job/query and relevance explanation; unassigned inventory search link
Rank bounded group summaries from deterministic index; optional semantic ranking is advisory
Failure: Budget exceeded returns smaller page/cursor, not all schemas
SCR04.C07 · Describe selected group
Fields: Member/type/cleanup IDs and exact next cursor
Read one selected group manifest page pinned to revision/hash
Failure: Stale group revision invalidates page; reload summary before client activation
SCR04.C08 · Discard mapping draft
Fields: Unsaved create/edit indicator
Discard mapping draft; keep committed mappings and client interests
Failure: No changes to client grants or loaded group view
SCR04.C09 · Edit functional group members
Fields: Stable group ID, member IDs, register/unregister pair, metadata evidence, size preview
Create or edit functional member list and required dependency closure as a draft
Failure: Unassigned entries remain searchable; cycles/oversize show errors before save
SCR04.C10 · Reload group mapping
Fields: Server revision, local diff and dependency changes
Reload current mapping revision after CAS conflict
Failure: Preserve local draft separately; fresh approval needed for changed command
State definitions — exact enabled/disabled controls, effects and recovery
SCR04.S0 · Group summary and local mapping draft
Disabled: none; owner/backend exact command checks remain
Effect: Search returns bounded summaries; owner preview is not client activation.
Recovery: Describe one group or edit atomic member/dependency draft.
SCR04.S1 · No group matches: unassigned inventory searchable
Disabled: SCR04.C01, SCR04.C02, SCR04.C07, SCR04.C08, SCR04.C10
Effect: No selected group; create draft and search remain possible.
Recovery: Broaden job/query or select unassigned bindings for a small new group.
SCR04.S2 · Atomic group budget/dependency exceeded
Disabled: SCR04.C02
Effect: No partial group saved or loaded; explain exact member/dependency excess.
Recovery: Remove optional scope or split into coherent atomic groups, then re-preview.
SCR04.S3 · Mapping CAS conflict
Disabled: SCR04.C02
Effect: No changes committed; prior session interests keep pinned revision only while authority valid.
Recovery: Reload mapping, merge explicit fields, then fresh owner save.
SCR04.S4 · Member editor: draft only
Disabled: none; owner/backend exact command checks remain
Effect: Register/unregister pairs and necessary types move as one coherent set.
Recovery: Save through SCR09 or discard; no grant or dynamic tool activation occurs.
